verdict_text: NO. The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6` and removes head 6 from every layer, but the specification's "Required result" requires removing head 5. For the fused `query_key_value` weight and bias this keeps rows `0..4607` and `5376..6143` instead of the required `0..3839` and `4608..6143`, violating clauses 1 and 2. For `attention.dense.weight` it keeps columns `0..1535` and `1792..2047` instead of `0..1279` and `1536..2047`, violating clause 3. The shape assertions pass because the wrong head has the same block size, so the output would fail the bit-exact value comparison in grading.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
